title: Effect of Ti additions on mechanical properties of NbMoTaW and VNbMoTaW refractory high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by arc melting of equimolar mixtures of Ti, Nb, Mo, Ta, and W (purity >99.96%), remelted five times for homogeneity, followed by annealing at 1200°C for 24 hours
